defects.claim: Acceptance bullet 2 is not met. The issue asks for every field that falls back to `—` to be listed under "Needs API" with the endpoint that would supply it. The PR body has only Summary, Changes (the issue text repeated) and Evidence. The fallbacks are Docs Created/Read this week, all Memory values, and Graph health/Nodes/Edges/Last updated. They are listed only in the docblock at src/design-system/components/ContextPanel.vue:11-15, not in the PR body.

The Docs header value is a client count of `docs.entries.length`. The type contract says not to client-recount entries because the tree may cap or paginate them independently of server totals (src/lib/api/types.ts:644-645). So the header can undercount when the server caps the tree.

ContextPanel sits inside the `hidden … md:grid` container (DashboardView.vue:367). Below 768px the Context column is not rendered at all. The issue asks for it to stack under the main column below 1280px.

The health thresholds (7d / 30d) were invented by the PR author and the docblock says "assumed — no backend definition exists yet". No caller ever passes `graph` (DashboardView.vue:367), so the word always renders `—` today. The rule needs product sign-off before a graph source exists.
The tests mount ContextPanel with hand-built props. No test covers the DashboardView wiring (`loadContextDocs` using `session.instances[0]`, or the failure path falling back to `—`).

notes:
- Right column 270px at ≥1280px: met (`xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_400px_270px]`). It stacks below xl from md upward but is absent below md (see defect above).
- "Context" header and three cards with 16px padding (`p-4`) and 13px rows (`text-[13px]`): met. All color classes are theme tokens (theme.css:8-27).
- Docs card: header shows the count and all three row labels are present. "Updated this week" is derived from `modifiedAt`, which the producer side relays at src/lib/api/httpAdapter.ts:268 and :519. `entries` is relayed at httpAdapter.ts:280 and consumed by getDocsTree at httpAdapter.ts:1743-1747. The fixture has it at src/lib/api/__tests__/fixtures/docs-tree.json:4. The other two rows show `—`, and no muted secondary number is shown.
- Memory card: header and rows all show `—`. No memory endpoint exists in the checkout. `memoriesRead`/`memoriesCreated` exist only as per-turn ChatEvent fields (types.ts:445-446), not as a weekly aggregate, so `—` is the honest choice.
- Graph card: health word with a `title` tooltip explaining the rule, plus Nodes/Edges/Last updated rows. No bare percentage appears, and the test asserts `not.toMatch(/\d+%/)`. Met.
- Data source: uses the same `getDocsTree` that DocsView uses (DocsView.vue:111). Met.
- Unit test for labels and the `—` fallback: met (ContextPanel.spec.ts:17-26). It exercises the component only; the adapter contract is covered separately by httpAdapter.spec.ts:1177.
- Acceptance bullet 2 ("Needs API" list): not met.
- make build/test/lint: the Evidence block shows a successful build, 69 files / 954 tests passed, and a clean `vue-tsc`. Met.
- No migrations. No out-of-scope changes; the rail and dark mode are untouched.
